title: Where's my visuals?
description: The ultimate Fabric 1.20.1 collection for maximum performance and modern visuals featuring Sodium Lithium and Iris Shaders with a minimalist pro HUD and 100 percent server compatibility.
body:
🚀 **Where's my visuals? | 1.20.1**
The Ultimate Fabric Client-Side Collection for Max FPS & Modern Graphics.

This suite is meticulously engineered to provide the smoothest Minecraft experience possible on version 1.20.1. By combining aggressive optimization with next-gen visual enhancements, it bridges the gap between raw performance and stunning aesthetics.

## ⚡ **High-End Performance**
Experience a lag-free world with a focus on stability and frame rates:

Core Engine: Powered by the Sodium, Lithium, and Starlight trinity for a massive FPS boost.

Memory Efficiency: FerriteCore drastically reduces RAM usage, preventing stutters.

Smooth World-Gen: Optimized chunk loading ensures zero ghost blocks and instant terrain rendering.

Entity Optimization: Advanced culling techniques keep your frames high even in crowded areas.

## 🎨 **Next-Gen Visuals**
Modernize your game's look without sacrificing the classic feel:

Shaders Support: Native Iris Shaders integration with full PBR (Physically Based Rendering) capabilities.

Fluid Lighting: Real-time Dynamic Lights that illuminate your surroundings while holding a torch.

Connected Textures: Seamless glass, paths, and bookshelves for a more polished environment.

Enhanced VFX: Refined particle effects and ultra-smooth animations for a more immersive feel.

## 🛠️ **Professional Utility & UX**
A suite of tools designed for power users and creators:

Pro HUD: A streamlined, non-intrusive F3 menu that shows only the data you actually need.

Precision Zoom: High-fidelity zoom functionality for scouting or cinematic captures.

Item Intelligence: Advanced Item Tooltips for quick inventory management and stats.

Minimalist Aim: Features a clean Dot Crosshair [•] for better visibility and focus.

## **🔒 Safety & Compatibility**
100% Client-Side: No server-side mods required. It works everywhere.

Multiplayer Safe: Fully compatible with Vanilla, Paper, and Fabric servers; no risk of bans or glitches.
